design_description: The Schalke Temeto jersey uses a crisp white and royal-blue identity, built around clean geometry and a classic European football aesthetic. The predominantly white body is defined by a single bold vertical royal-blue stripe, positioned asymmetrically through the crest side and running uninterrupted from shoulder to hem. Slim blue contour lines along the side panels reinforce the athletic silhouette without overcrowding the design. The shoulders feature parallel royal-blue stripes, while blue sleeve inserts, cuffs and fine collar detailing create a consistent frame around the white base. The Schalke Temeto crest integrates directly into the main vertical stripe, making the club identity part of the actual composition. The central PROJECTX sponsor remains highly legible in black, with the red 'X' providing the only contrasting accent outside the core blue-and-white palette. Momuto branding and the Superliga Aragón sleeve patch complete the match-ready presentation. Overall, it is a clean, traditional and highly recognizable design: strong Schalke-inspired blue and white, an asymmetric statement stripe, restrained detailing and a professional competition aesthetic.
